_comment: The results specification's measure vocabulary (0.2): canonical name -> modality (or, for a measure several modalities use, modalities), description, aliases. A known measure is written by its canonical name; an analysis may list a measure not here (the checker warns) -- add it here, in neurobox-dev, with a CHANGELOG line, rather than inventing a spelling. EEG measures were added in 0.4.

volume.description: region or tissue volume (mm^3 unless the column dictionary says otherwise)

GM.description: grey-matter probability or volume, as the analysis states

WM.description: white-matter probability or volume, as the analysis states

CSF.description: CSF probability or volume, as the analysis states

GM_mod.description: grey-matter probability modulated by the Jacobian (VBM)

WM_mod.description: white-matter probability modulated by the Jacobian (VBM)

logJ_total.description: log-Jacobian of a deformation, affine included (TBM)

logJ_local.description: log-Jacobian of a deformation, affine removed (TBM; change relative to the whole brain)

MWF.description: myelin water fraction (T2 spectrum below the myelin cutoff)

IWF.description: intra- and extra-cellular water fraction (T2 spectrum between the cutoffs)

CSWF.description: CSF water fraction (T2 spectrum above the upper cutoff)

fALFF.description: fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (resting-state BOLD)

FC.description: functional connectivity (correlation of regional BOLD time series)

NAA.description: N-acetylaspartate (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

NAAG.description: N-acetylaspartylglutamate (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

NAA+NAAG.description: total N-acetylaspartate (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Cr.description: creatine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

PCr.description: phosphocreatine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Cr+PCr.description: total creatine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

GPC.description: glycerophosphocholine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

PCh.description: phosphocholine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

GPC+PCh.description: total choline (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Ins.description: myo-inositol (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Glu.description: glutamate (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Gln.description: glutamine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Glu+Gln.description: glutamate + glutamine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

GABA.description: gamma-aminobutyric acid (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

GSH.description: glutathione (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Tau.description: taurine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Lac.description: lactate (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Ala.description: alanine (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

Asp.description: aspartate (MRS concentration, in the units the column dictionary states)

band_power.description: absolute band power: mean power density over the band, dB/Hz

relative_power.description: relative band power: the band's fraction of total power

aperiodic_exponent.description: aperiodic (1/f) exponent of the power spectrum (specparam/FOOOF)

aperiodic_offset.description: aperiodic (1/f) offset of the power spectrum (specparam/FOOOF)

dwpli.description: debiased weighted phase-lag index (Vinck et al. 2011)

fcd.description: functional connectivity density: degree / (n - 1) above threshold

pac_mi.description: phase-amplitude coupling, Tort et al. (2010) modulation index

aac.description: amplitude-amplitude coupling: correlation of two bands' power envelopes

auc.description: area under the ROC curve of a decoder

degree.description: node degree in a thresholded network (graph theory)

global_efficiency.description: global efficiency of a network (graph theory)
